notes.title: Game is becoming free
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

So long story short, ive decided to make this game a free game. I originally posted the game with a cheap pricetag so that friends and family who wanted to support me could, but have decided that was a really dumb decision. As such, I am currently in contact with steam to transition this game into becoming a free game. For anyone who has not purchased the game but wishes to play it, you could either wait the month for steam to change the price tag, or you could download the game from itch.io, where it is currently free. The link is here: https://jjthejetplane27.itch.io/from-them

For anyone else who was unable to access the project files, I apologize. Basically I had the idea to add it as a free DLC for this game and users who wanted it could download that specific item by itself, but the way steam sets up dlcs was a little complicated and I just never got around to listing it with the game. If you are interested in exploring how I made the game, I will again push you towards the Itch.io listing, as I have provided the download for the project files there. Understand that this project was my first foray into making a game, and there are loads of things I would do differently, and will be doing differently in the future.

With all this out of the way, to the people who did purchase the game, I thank you immensely. I know the only people who really looked at this project were friends and family, but regardless I appreciate the support as I learn more about Unreal Engine and game development in general. Moving forward, I hope to see you all again in my next project.

notes.title: Coming soon announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

I just figure i should put out an announcement as to the reason I made this game, along with some additional details. This game was originally created so that i could learn how to operate Unreal Engine 5, and post a game on steam so i can have something to say ive created. I have a video ive made about my experience, and if your interested in watching, you can find it here.

 [previewyoutube=n3xunlIcj5A;full][/previewyoutube]

Apart from that, this game has a free dlc available with all the unreal engine project code available. To open this, install Unreal engine 5.4 on your computer through the epic games launcher (If you are not interested in this, I would suggest not downloading the dlc, as its like 3 extra GB for nothing. I will be releasing a video later this week that shows all the important bits of code and how to edit it. Anyway thank you all for your interest in my small little project, and i hope we can learn together!
